arguments.sql: SELECT 'jrnl_balance' chk, COUNT(*) n, SUM("DR_AMT") dr, SUM("CR_AMT") cr FROM "GLJRNL" UNION ALL SELECT 'unbalanced_jrnls', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY "JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM("DR_AMT") <> SUM("CR_AMT")) x UNION ALL SELECT 'jrnl_no_header', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO") UNION ALL SELECT 'acct_not_in_coa', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" a WHERE a."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD") UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_dr_or_cr', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT"<0 OR "CR_AMT"<0 UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_no_jrnl', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO") UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_no_inv', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID") UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_no_vend', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APVEND" v WHERE v."VEND_CD"=i."VEND_CD") UNION ALL SELECT 'paid_inv_no_pay', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL FROM "APINVH" i WHERE "STAT_CD"='P' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID");

SELECT 'APINVH' t, MIN("INV_DT") mn, MAX("INV_DT") mx, MIN(LENGTH(CAST("INV_DT" AS TEXT))) l1, MAX(LENGTH(CAST("INV_DT" AS TEXT))) l2 FROM "APINVH" UNION ALL SELECT 'APPAYM', MIN("PAY_DT"), MAX("PAY_DT"), MIN(LENGTH(CAST("PAY_DT" AS TEXT))), MAX(LENGTH(CAST("PAY_DT" AS TEXT))) FROM "APPAYM" UNION ALL SELECT 'GLJRNH', MIN("POST_DT"), MAX("POST_DT"), MIN(LENGTH(CAST("POST_DT" AS TEXT))), MAX(LENGTH(CAST("POST_DT" AS TEXT))) FROM "GLJRNH" UNION ALL SELECT 'GLPERD', MIN("STRT_DT"), MAX("END_DT"), MIN("PRD_ID"), MAX("PRD_ID") FROM "GLPERD";

SELECT 'O_with_pay' chk, COUNT(*) n FROM "APINVH" i WHERE "STAT_CD"='O' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID") UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_open_inv', COUNT(*) FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_AMT"<0 UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_inv_by_stat_' || "STAT_CD", COUNT(*) FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_AMT"<0 GROUP BY "STAT_CD" UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_gt_inv', COUNT(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE ABS((SELECT COALESCE(SUM("PAY_AMT"),0) FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")) > ABS(i."INV_AMT") UNION ALL SELECT 'closed_period_jrnls', COUNT(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE p."STAT_CD"='C' UNION ALL SELECT 'jrnl_period_missing', COUNT(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLPERD" p WHERE p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID") UNION ALL SELECT 'ref_jrnl_set', COUNT(*) FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL;
